final: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, CAST(SUM(w) AS REAL)/COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS avg_wins, AVG(CASE WHEN l<>0 THEN CAST(g-l AS REAL)/l END) AS avg_ratio FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM t) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_wins - m.mean_wins AS gap FROM t, m WHERE t.avg_wins > m.mean_wins ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
